remarks:
Welcome to this charming and well-maintained Dunkirk home offering over 1,500 square feet, four bedrooms, and plenty of room to spread out! From the moment you arrive, you’ll love the beautiful covered front porch, perfect for relaxing and enjoying the neighborhood.

Inside, you’ll find original woodwork, nice vinyl flooring, attractive colors, and plenty of character. The spacious layout offers flexibility for today’s lifestyle, including an extra room that could make the perfect home office, craft room, playroom, or hobby space. The sellers have already done the hard part — they’re packed and ready to go, giving you the opportunity to make this well-loved home your own.

Outside, enjoy the **fully fenced yard**, perfect for pets, entertaining, gardening, or simply relaxing outdoors. Major updates are already taken care of, including a **new roof and leaf guard system**. A huge attic and basement provide an abundance of additional storage.

The location is hard to beat, with Lake Erie, shopping, restaurants, major interstate access, Fredonia and everyday conveniences all nearby. Add in affordable taxes, an attractive price, four bedrooms, and all this living space, and this is an opportunity you won’t want to miss. **Bring your vision, make a few easy updates, and turn this charming Dunkirk home into your own!  Open house is 9/12 from 11 to 1.
